The '''Friends of Paran base''' was an underground resistance facility operated by the [[Friends of Paran]]. It was located in the industrial [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Knellis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]], in the basement of an industrial factory complex.
